title: Document
主要内容: T-Mobile US, Inc. completed its business combination with Sprint Corporation on April 1, 2020. The Current Report on Form 8-K includes historical audited consolidated financial statements of Sprint and subsidiaries as of March 31, 2020 and 2019, along with related consolidated statements of operations, comprehensive (loss) income, cash flows, and changes in equity for the three-year period ended March 31, 2020. The financial statements do not represent the consolidated results of operations or financial condition of the combined company. The historical financial information included herewith has not been adjusted to give effect to matters that are directly attributable to the merger of Sprint and T-Mobile which occurred subsequent to the end of the reported accounting period and the financial statements of the combined company will reflect significant differences due to purchase price accounting, accounting policy alignment and other adjustments and assumptions.
